title: A preview URL for every pull request with AWS Lambda Web Functions
description: Give every GitHub pull request its own live preview URL on a Lambda Web Function endpoint, updated on each push and deleted on close.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern gives every pull request in a GitHub repository its own live preview URL, the way hosting platforms such as Vercel and Netlify do, using one AWS Lambda Web Function. A GitHub Actions workflow deploys each pull request to an endpoint named pr-<number>, comments the URL on the pull request, updates the same URL on every push and deletes the endpoint when the pull request closes. Merging to main deploys the prod endpoint.

A Web Function can have up to 10 endpoints, each with its own HTTPS domain, and an endpoint with Disabled auto-deployment keeps serving the revision that you point it at. Every endpoint in this pattern uses Disabled: with the default LatestRevision, production would serve the code of the last pull request that was pushed.

The workflows assume AWS IAM roles with GitHub OpenID Connect, so the repository stores no AWS keys. Because each endpoint has its own ARN, the preview role can change only pr-* endpoints and can pass only a separate preview execution role, so pull request code cannot touch the production endpoint or run with production permissions.
Idle previews scale to zero, and each preview endpoint is capped at 2 execution environments and 100 requests per second.

bullets.text: Deployment patterns for Lambda Web Functions
Configuring OpenID Connect in Amazon Web Services for GitHub Actions

text: Get your repository's OIDC subject prefix with gh api repos/my-org/my-repo/actions/oidc/customization/sub --jq .sub_claim_prefix.
Deploy the stack: sam deploy --stack-name lambda-web-pr-previews --region us-east-1 --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --parameter-overrides GitHubSubjectPrefix=<prefix>.
Deploy production: AWS_REGION=us-east-1 scripts/deploy.sh production. Then copy src, scripts and .github into your repository and set the repository variables described in the GitHub repo.
Create a preview from your terminal with AWS_REGION=us-east-1 scripts/deploy.sh preview 1, or open a pull request in your repository. See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
Delete the Web Function and empty the code bucket: AWS_REGION=us-east-1 scripts/deploy.sh destroy.
Delete the stack: sam delete --stack-name lambda-web-pr-previews --region us-east-1 --no-prompts.
